results.title: Janhvi Kapoor recreates Sridevi’s iconic Nagina look for Halloween; Khushi Kapoor, Kareena Kapoor Khan and others react
results.description: Janhvi Kapoor gave Halloween a nostalgic Bollywood twist this year as she recreated her mother Sridevi’s iconic look from the 1986 film Nagina. The actor shared a series of pictures on Instagram, paying tribute to one of Hindi cinema’s memorable fantasy films. The recreation also featured Orry, who stepped into Rishi Kapoor’s look, while Janhvi’s friend Vaishnav Praveen recreated Amrish Puri’s character. Sharing the pictures, Janhvi wrote, “Happy Halloweeeeeny… had to recreate one of the most iconic movie moments everrrrr…” Explaining her choice of costume, she added, “So much of Halloween has become about dressing up as your favourite characters and pop culture moments. Sometimes they’re spooky, sometimes they’re funny, and sometimes it’s a tribute.” The actor also acknowledged the stars whose characters inspired the recreation, writing, “And who could possibly be more iconic than Mumma, Rishi uncle and Amrish sir!!” She concluded her caption by appreciating the people who helped put the look together, saying, “Got a little help from for the lewk.” The post drew reactions from several members of the film fraternity, including Janhvi’s sister Khushi Kapoor, who commented, “You won Halloween” along with heart-eye emojis. Her cousin Shanaya Kapoor and aunt Maheep Kapoor also responded with heart emojis. Kareena Kapoor Khan, Karisma Kapoor, Riddhima Kapoor Sahni, Sanya Malhotra, Ananya Panday and Zoya Akhtar were among the other industry members who reacted to the pictures. Released in 1986, Nagina featured Sridevi as Rajni, a shape-shifting serpent woman, alongside Rishi Kapoor and Amrish Puri. The film, directed by Harmesh Malhotra, became widely remembered for Sridevi’s performance and its fantasy elements. Its song ‘Main Teri Dushman, Dushman Tu Mera’ also remains closely associated with the film. Janhvi’s Halloween post brought the film back into conversation, combining a festive costume recreation with a tribute to her mother’s screen legacy. By bringing together the looks of three actors from the original film, the post also offered a nostalgic reminder of a much-loved chapter in Hindi cinema.
